item.title: North Dakota sets waterfowl season dates for 2026
item.description: BISMARCK, ND (KXNET) — North Dakota Game and Fish announces waterfowl season dates for residents and while nonresidents. item.title: Minot 8th grader wins second straight State Spelling Bee
item.description: Thousands of smart boys and girls made a trip to the capital city to vie for the spelling championship. Minot 8th grader Chilaka Ugobi won the state spelling bee for the second year in a row, clinching it with the word 'eviscerate.'

item.title: Bismarck voters to decide on $127 million public school referendum
item.description: Bismarck voters will decide on a new referendum seeking to use $127 million to address public school facility needs throughout the state capital.

item.title: NDGF to count mule deer throughout state next week
item.description: Next week, a pilot will take off on a mission to count mule deer in North Dakota. That's part of the spring aerial mule deer survey.
